//: The extensions this build ships, injected at build time (vite.extensions.ts). Point THOREMIN_EXTENSIONS at another file to build with a different set. `module` is the pure manifest (an Extension, default export); `ui` is its React half (an ExtensionUi, default export). An optional `lazy: { module, ui }` makes the extension LAZY: `module`/`ui` are then small eager stubs and `lazy.*` the deferred halves, loaded by dynamic import() only when a graph names its nodes or its section opens (docs/design/lazy-extensions.md).
